I can't give you any Daniel 8 notes yet. None of my page reads worked, so I have nothing from the approved sites to base notes on. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't written anything from my own knowledge.

My first attempt broke on a coding error before I could see any results. When I tried again, I had hit the tool limit and couldn't fetch any more pages.

These are the pages I'll read when I retry:
- **Verse-by-verse commentaries:** enduringword.com (Daniel 8); Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on biblehub.com; preceptaustin.org (Daniel 8)
- **Modern scholarship:** netbible.org (the translators' notes on Daniel 8) and bibleodyssey.org (on Antiochus IV, the "little horn," and when Daniel was written)
- **Where interpretations differ:** gotquestions.org and other sources on the 2,300 evenings and mornings (vv. 13–14). This includes whether it means 2,300 days or 1,150, and whether the little horn is only Antiochus or also points to a future Antichrist.
- **Catholic and Orthodox:** newadvent.org (for example, the Church Fathers on Daniel) and catholic.com
- **Each Protestant tradition's own teachers:** for instance, Wesley's notes on wesley.nnu.edu and pieces on Ligonier or Desiring God

If you'd like me to go ahead, just say "continue." I'll then write the notes verse by verse ("v. 4: …"), with a URL after each point and nothing included that I couldn't find.
